integrity: An explicit all-parameter proof and a standalone exact finite checker are included. Finite tests are supplementary, and no independent validation or formal certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two uniform finite consecutive-digit progressions with distinct prime lengths and commensurable coprime positive steps only. It is not an infinite-convolution or nonuniform-weight result. The elementary resonant basis construction is not claimed independently novel; originality concerns the all-parameter quantitative nonresonant packing bound and rigidity, subject to possible unindexed equivalent literature.
title: A prime-resonance dichotomy for orthogonal exponentials of two finite digit convolutions
